reason: My channel earns nothing yet, so paying ₹99 a month for an AI coach feels like throwing money away. I already open YouTube Studio every morning and can see my own numbers there for free.
objection: Will this tell me anything I can't work out from YouTube Studio and from what the big channels in my niche post this week? If not, I'm paying to copy what I could copy anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a clear example, using my own channel, that shows a title or video idea that actually brought in more views.
